Percentiles of daily values by unit and month

Source: R/calc_percentile.R
calc_percentile.Rd

Computes, for each unit and calendar month, percentiles of the daily values over all years of the baseline, e.g. the 90th percentile of maximum temperature in July. These are the relative thresholds that calc_percentile_day() compares each day with. Replaces calc_pct_day().

Usage

calc_percentile(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
calc_percentile(
  x,
  p,
  exclude_below = NULL,
  exclude_above = NULL,
  yearly = FALSE,
  baseline = NULL,
  replace = NA_real_,
  id = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  chunk = "auto",
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A wide table from extract_*(), or a long indicator table.

...

Further arguments of the methods; the table method takes none.

p

Probabilities, e.g. c(0.1, 0.9).

exclude_below, exclude_above

Values beyond these are left out.

yearly

When TRUE, also compute percentiles over all days of the year (columns yr_90p), repeated on every month.

baseline

Optional dates c(from, to) limiting the days used, e.g. c("1991-01-01", "2020-12-31").

replace

Value for a unit and month with no data.

id

Optional name of the unit identifier column.

label

Optional name shown in progress messages.

chunk

"auto" splits the work by unit when it would not fit in memory; a whole number forces that many units per chunk; FALSE never splits.

Value

A c4e_tbl lookup table: the unit identifiers, month ("01" to "12") and one column per percentile (day_90p), registered with their probability and baseline.

Details

Use exclude_below to leave out values, for instance days with less than 0.1 mm of rain, so the percentiles describe wet days only. A unit and month left with no value gets replace (by default NA, so no day is flagged against it).

See also

calc_percentile_day(), calc_spell_percentile()

Other indicators: calc_condition(), calc_heatwave(), calc_par(), calc_percentile_day(), calc_spell(), calc_spell_excess(), calc_spell_percentile(), calc_std_index(), calc_std_threshold(), calc_threshold_day()

Examples

pre <- read_climate(
  system.file("extdata", "pre_daily.tif", package = "c4e"))
#> Read pre_daily: pre [mm/day], daily, 2021-01-01 to 2023-12-31, 1095 layers
#> (synthetic).
survey <- read.csv(
  system.file("extdata", "survey.csv", package = "c4e"))
coord <- prepare_coord(survey, lat_var = lat, lon_var = lon)
points <- georef_coord(coord, geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

extract_by_coord(pre, points) |>
  calc_percentile(p = c(0.9, 0.99), exclude_below = 0.1)
